summary: Dispatches StateDependentUpdateDispatch over six arrays of 36-byte objects held in a single struct. Each batch has a count field and a base pointer field; three batches start from index 0, three start from a fixed start index (416, 208, 832) below which no objects exist. Resets this+0x6C to 0. Returns the last batch's count (this+0x60). Called by DynMan_Restart.

operations.description: Batch 1: for index 0..this+0x24-1, call StateDependentUpdateDispatch(base at this+0x28 + index*36).
Batch 2 (guard this+0x30 > 0): for index 0..this+0x30-1, call StateDependentUpdateDispatch(base at this+0x34 + index*36).
Batch 3 (guard this+0x3C > 0): for index 0..this+0x3C-1, call StateDependentUpdateDispatch(base at this+0x40 + index*36).
Batch 4 (guard this+0x48 > 416): for index 416..this+0x48-1, call StateDependentUpdateDispatch(base at this+0x4C + index*36); start pointer offset 14976 = 416*36.
Batch 5 (guard this+0x54 > 208): for index 208..this+0x54-1, call StateDependentUpdateDispatch(base at this+0x58 + index*36); start pointer offset 7488 = 208*36.
Batch 6 (guard this+0x60 > 832): for index 832..this+0x60-1, call StateDependentUpdateDispatch(base at this+0x64 + index*36); start pointer offset 29952 = 832*36.
Return this+0x60 (last batch's count, reloaded each loop iteration).

clean_pseudocode: for (i = 0; i < this->f24; i++) StateDependentUpdateDispatch(this->f28 + i*36);
if (this->f30 > 0) for (i = 0; i < this->f30; i++) StateDependentUpdateDispatch(this->f34 + i*36);
if (this->f3C > 0) for (i = 0; i < this->f3C; i++) StateDependentUpdateDispatch(this->f40 + i*36);
if (this->f48 > 416) for (i = 416; i < this->f48; i++) StateDependentUpdateDispatch(this->f4C + i*36);
if (this->f54 > 208) for (i = 208; i < this->f54; i++) StateDependentUpdateDispatch(this->f58 + i*36);
if (this->f60 > 832) for (i = 832; i < this->f60; i++) StateDependentUpdateDispatch(this->f64 + i*36);
